reply.answer_text: As at 13 July 2026, unused pension funds are not yet in the estate for IHT purposes. However, from 6 April 2027 — just under nine months away — the rule changes. From that date, most unused pension funds and death benefits will fall within the estate for IHT, though spouse/civil-partner and charity exemptions continue. This is a legislated change. You should plan ahead with a financial or tax adviser if you expect this to affect your estate.
